domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: bfw.co.in and bfwindia.com returned only product-catalogue content ("CNC Machining Centers - Vertical & Horizontal Machining Centres ... bfwmarketing@bfw.co.in"), and volza.com / eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore rests on the company's own product/website claims, not on a verifiable transaction record.
note: Manufacturer of CNC machining centres (Peenya/Yeshwanthpur, Bangalore). Export side is factually supported: a dated outbound customs record (2026-02-26, Bangalore ICD -> Haiphong, Vietnam, HS 84571020, BOL 1059265) plus recurring foreign buyer counterparties (BFW Europe France, Sept-Fons PSA France, SVRS General Trading UAE, Samchully Korea, Interstail Plyus Kyrgyzstan) with shipment counts. Caveat: the one visible outbound row is a machine sent for testing and return, so it is not a commercial sale; the commercial export evidence is the buyer-counterparty counts, which are aggregates without dates or B/L numbers. Declared HS 820750 (interchangeable tools for drilling) does not match the observed trade, which is HS 8457/8458/8466 (machining centres and parts) - per project rules this is not a rejection ground; actual HS is 84571020 / 84669310 / 845819-class. Domestic supply: no GST turnover, tender or contract record found in accessible sources - declared, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in accessible sources).
